setup_wandb: initialize wandb with detectron2 config and args for experiment tracking on the main process
create_wandb_writer: create a WandbWriter instance to log scalars, images, and histograms from detectron2 event storage to wandb
use_wandb_writer_write: call write on WandbWriter to flush latest scalars, images, and histograms to wandb with grouping rules
use_isin_rule: use the IsIn rule class to check if a keyword is present in a scalar name string
use_prefix_rule: use the Prefix rule class to prepend a keyword prefix to a scalar name with a slash separator
